what_it_measured.text: In this study, the activity of alkaline phosphatase (ALP) and osteocalcin (OCN), the regulation of RUNX2, and the expression of TβRI were investigated to elucidate the underlying mechanism.

dose.text: MC3T3-E1 cells were treated with 0–70 µM CBP for 7 days. n = 3.

endpoint.text: Absorption values were measured at 570 nm (OD570 ) with a microplate reader (Molecular Devices, San Jose, CA, USA). 2.5.
Finally, the absorbance of the destaining solution was measured with a microplate reader at 490 nm (OD490 ) [22]. 2.6.
The cells were rinsed with H2 O thrice and assessed with an optical microscope (Leica DMi8, Wetzlar, Germany).

reported_results.text: Meanwhile, an increase of 33.96% in OCN activity was observed after 24 h of 70 µM CBP treatment.
Meanwhile, we found that CBP significantly increased the RFI of the bone mass in a dose-dependent manner (p < 0.001) (Figure 7B).

numbers.text: MC3T3-E1 cells were treated with 0–70 µM CBP for 7 days. n = 3.
Absorption values were measured at 570 nm (OD570 ) with a microplate reader (Molecular Devices, San Jose, CA, USA). 2.5.
Finally, the absorbance of the destaining solution was measured with a microplate reader at 490 nm (OD490 ) [22]. 2.6.
Meanwhile, an increase of 33.96% in OCN activity was observed after 24 h of 70 µM CBP treatment.
Meanwhile, we found that CBP significantly increased the RFI of the bone mass in a dose-dependent manner (p < 0.001) (Figure 7B).
